items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I remember when I was a youngster I used to get the magazines with Charles Atlas and all of the savs(?) you could send for and sell

ctx.x: Banjo Bernie, do you remember what his whole name was, or was that all the name you ever heard?

I don't remember his name. I know he had a first name, but everybody called him Banjo Bernie, because that's what he played -- banjo and guitar. But the banjo seems to have stuck, because banjo was a popular instrument during that time. I remember when I was a youngster I used to get the magazines with Charles Atlas and all of the savs(?) you could send for and sell, and you could earn a ukelele. So my choice was a banjo uke. And I learned two or three chords on it, but that really wasn't my thing.
